Demo Web Shop · Annotated guest checkout

Expert review against one goal (applied by hand) + Nielsen heuristics · Walkthrough 14 Nov 2026 · Draft for discussion · Personal data blurred

Goal (KR)Raise checkout completion rate
PersonaNour, doubtful first-time buyer who compares with Amazon (example)
Findings26 pins on 11 screens · 8 high · 12 medium · 6 low · 2 strengths
HeadlineCart total 10.00 becomes 17.00 at the last step: a flat 7.00 fee (+70% on this 10.00 item)
High: likely to stop a purchaseMedium: erodes trust or slowsLow: polishStrength: keepKR fit = how well the screen serves checkout completion (1–5)
Home pageShopping cartClick Checkout without the tickSign-in wallCheckout step 1: Billing addressCheckout step 2: Shipping addressCheckout step 3: Shipping methodCheckout step 4: Payment methodCheckout step 5: Payment informationCheckout step 6: Confirm orderThank-you pageThemes

1 · Home page

Nour: "Is this a real shop? Why is it asking me about nopCommerce?"

1234
  1. 1
    E20 · Medium · Trust
    Slider advertises Tricentis Academy, not products or offers.
  2. 2
    E20 · Medium · Trust
    "Do you like nopCommerce?" poll: leftover template content.
  3. 3
    E21 · Strength · Keep
    Strength: star ratings and a clear green "Add to cart" on every card.
  4. 4
    E3 · Medium · Trust

2 · Shopping cart KR fit 2/5

Nour: "Shipping is free? Great… is it really?"

1234
  1. 1
    E7 · High · Hidden cost
    Shipping shows 0.00 before any estimate, so it looks free when it may not be.
  2. 2
    E7 · High · Hidden cost
    The buyer must fill country, state and ZIP by hand to see a shipping estimate.
  3. 3
    E8 · Medium · Friction
    Terms tick sits under the totals; wording "adhere to them unconditionally" is harsh.
  4. 4
    E9 · Low · Trust
    Coupon and gift-card boxes are prominent; no payment logos or security cues.

Nour: "Why didn't you just tell me before I clicked?"

1
  1. 1

Nour: "Do I have to make an account just to buy one book?"

8 · Checkout step 4: Payment method KR fit 2/5

Nour: "Finally I see how I can pay, at step 4. And what is (7.00)?"

1234
  1. 1
    E14 · High · Hidden cost
    Payment options appear for the first time at step 4 of 6.
  2. 2
    E15 · High · Hidden cost
    Cash on Delivery carries a 7.00 fee shown only as "(7.00)", with no word "fee".

  2. 2

What the pins add up to: 3 themes

1 · Hidden costs and dates

Fake 0.00 shipping in the cart, payment methods first shown at step 4, a 7.00 fee revealed at the end, no delivery date anywhere.
E7 · E14 · E15 · E17 · E19

2 · Trust gaps

Placeholder text on four pages, an empty Shipping & Returns page, no currency, a slider that advertises something else.
E1 · E3 · E11 · E13 · E20 · E22

3 · Extra friction

Terms pop-up after the click, a weak guest button, a step with one sentence, exits everywhere.
E8 · E10 · E12 · E16 · E18

Method and limits. No users were interviewed: none were reachable and the site is a test shop. Findings come from one guest walkthrough scored against the KR. Behaviour (how many buyers actually leave at each step) would need funnel analytics, session recordings or an exit survey. Product page and Shipping & Returns findings (E1–E6) are in the evidence log.
